decision_notes: The parliament live page explicitly designates its YouTube plenary archive. Distinct 28 and 30 September 2026 recordings decode in Chromium and WebKit; selected frames show different speakers at the parliamentary lectern with crest and lit microphone. Parliamentary rules establish legislative and budgetary powers within autonomy and Swedish as the working language. This validates selected archived plenaries, not all sessions, live or committees.
The reviewed institutional live page designates public viewing; no blanket independent audiovisual reuse grant was established. Personal-use permission remains pending. Link to the official service.
